name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A centred alert dialog: the scrim fades in while the card springs from 0.92 to full size, with an optional living tone icon that draws itself in a glowing halo. Modern pill buttons or iOS hairline buttons, side by side or stacked; danger-coloured destructive confirms with a warning haptic, async spinners, a prompt field, and a shake when the confirm is invalid. Use Action Sheet for bottom actions.
summary: A centred alert whose card springs up from 0.92 while its tone icon draws itself.
behavior: The scrim fades in while the card springs to full size. A confirm that returns false keeps it open and shakes it.
The card fades in without the scale spring, and the tone icon appears fully drawn instead of animating. The shake is skipped.
A warning tick on open for destructive, warning and danger dialogs, success for the success tone, and an error buzz on shake.
The title is a header; destructive, warning and danger dialogs use the alert role. Buttons report disabled and busy, and the error text is a polite live region.
Escape closes it on web, and Return submits a prompt field.
props: Called on scrim tap, back, Escape and actions.
Destructive adds a warning icon, a danger confirm and a warning haptic on open. The old "sheet" value is deprecated and renders as default.
Living icon in a halo above the title with a soft glow of its colour; success / warning open with a matching haptic.
Pill buttons, or iOS full-width text buttons split by hairlines.
{ defaultValue?, value?, onChangeText?, placeholder?, secureTextEntry?, keyboardType?, maxLength?, … }
Adds a text field (a prompt dialog). Its text is passed to onConfirm / onPress; Return submits.
Error text under the field or description.
Buttons. role: primary | default | destructive | cancel. onPress(value) may return a promise (spinner) or false (stays open and shakes).
Labels for the default buttons; cancelLabel null leaves a single button.
Handlers for the default buttons (onCancel also fires on scrim, back and Escape).
Spinner on the confirm button; other buttons and dismissal are disabled.
Two short buttons side by side, otherwise stacked with Cancel last.
Custom node inside the halo, or false to hide it.
Close on scrim tap, back and Escape.
Warning on open for destructive dialogs, success for success, error on shake.
